summary: Southern Copper Corporation filed an 8-K furnishing a press release from its Peruvian branch Southern Peru Copper Corporation (SPCC) announcing a US$1.25 billion bond offering in the New York market to finance the Tía María mining project. The bonds carry a 5.35% annual interest rate maturing in 2036. The project, using SX-EW technology, targets 120,000 metric tons of refined copper per year with operations expected to begin in Q3 2027. This is a standard financing transaction, not a special situation; the filing serves as a voluntary disclosure of an ordinary debt issuance.
